title: Mechanical Properties and Deposition Mechanism of Cold-Sprayed CoNiCrAlY/YSZ Cermet

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: YSZ powder is 70-90 nm in size
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: grit-blasting process using Al2O3 media 100 µm in diameter

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: PCS-800, PLASMA GIKEN Co. LTD., Japan
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: A bond coat of CoNiCrAlY was sprayed before the primary feedstock, with He gas at 3.0 MPa and 600°C, and a powder feed rate of 12.4 g/min, standoff of 20 mm, and a raster speed of 50 mm/s. After spraying, samples were mounted in a phenolic resin and manually mirror-polished

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: a coating of Y-cermet powder with well-distributed YSZ powders was successfully deposited by cold-spraying. homogeneous microstructure, and cracks and voids are nearly invisible both at the bonding layer between the coating and the substrate and within the coating layer itself. significant plastic deformation of the feedstock powder, leading to the material’s densification. Y-cermet particles do not experience plastic deformation as general metal particles do, they break apart and a significant fraction of concentrated YSZ region. no phase transformation occurred in the cold-spraying and no metal oxidation was observed.
